archetype: Archetype 5 (Luxury / Cinematic Depth) blended with Archetype 4 (Swiss/High-Contrast) for dashboard density
domain: Music School Management System (Admin & Teacher Dashboard)

rules: No generic sans (Inter/Roboto) for headings. Use Cabinet Grotesk.
Never center-align standard dashboard text. Keep left-aligned for scannability.

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: MODE B: THE CONTROL ROOM GRID
spacing_and_layout.general_spacing: Dense but readable. Use p-6 or p-8 for main cards. gap-4 or gap-6 for dashboard bento grids.
spacing_and_layout.page_structure: Left compact sidebar (w-64) for navigation, with main content area scaling responsive (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4).
rules: Every pixel utilized, h-full on grid children to match neighbor heights.
Mobile-first: default to grid-cols-1 on small screens.
Always include pt-[header-height] if using sticky/fixed headers.

surface_strategies.cards: Grid Borders & Crystal Glass. bg-[#1A0B2E]/60 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10. No aggressive drop shadows.
surface_strategies.sidebar: Solid dark background bg-[#090412] with a sharp right border border-white/10.
surface_strategies.modals: Glassmorphism overlay bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-sm. Modal surface pure bg-[#1A0B2E] with border border-white/10.

buttons.primary: bg-[#FFB800] text-[#090412] font-semibold hover:bg-[#FFC933] transition-colors rounded-none
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-white/20 text-[#F4F0FA] hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors rounded-none
buttons.ghost: bg-transparent text-[#A291B5] hover:text-[#F4F0FA] hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors rounded-none

components.inputs: Shadcn standard but customized: bg-[#090412] border-white/10 text-[#F4F0FA] focus:border-[#FFB800] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#FFB800] rounded-none
components.tables: Shadcn table. Header text overline style (text-xs uppercase tracking-widest text-[#A291B5]). Rows have hover:bg-white/5.
components.badges: Flat background with high contrast text. e.g., bg-[#FFB800]/20 text-[#FFB800].
shadcn_overrides: Use flat/rectangular geometry (rounded-none or max rounded-sm).
Customize dropdowns and selects to match the midnight purple background.
Use Shadcn calendar for class scheduling.

motion.hover: Subtle background color shifts and border highlights. No bouncing.
motion.page_load: Staggered fade-up for dashboard widgets (framer-motion if available, or simple CSS keyframes).

icons.style: Duotone or Regular weight. Size 20px or 24px.

image_urls.description: Abstract midnight purple background texture, subtle velvet-like dark gradient with very fine film grain. Use for login page background or empty states.
Dark music piano keys. Use for decorative banners or dashboard greeting section.
A teacher instructs a student in musical notation. Use for teacher profiles or onboarding.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure all text passes APCA/WCAG standards against the #1A0B2E surfaces.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid. Examples: data-testid='login-button', data-testid='create-class-button', data-testid='teacher-row-actions', data-testid='attendance-checkbox'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use pure React, Tailwind CSS, and Shadcn UI.
Strictly adhere to the dark midnight purple palette. Do NOT use default gray/white cards.
Install and use @phosphor-icons/react for all icons.
For the dashboard metrics, use Shadcn Charts or Recharts styled with the primary/accent colors.
Ensure the dashboard navigation is always visible (no desktop hamburger menus).
All forms MUST use Shadcn form components customized for dark mode.
DO NOT use the default teal/purple gradient for CTA. The primary action color MUST be #FFB800 (Amber/Gold) to contrast the purple.
Add 'data-testid' to every form input, button, and table row action.
DO NOT use standard rounded-xl or rounded-2xl. Use 'rounded-none' or at most 'rounded-sm' to maintain a sharp, technical, high-end admin feel.
